title: Baseline Anchoring & Root Cause Lattice for Route/Model/Region Latency
creator: Anika Patel
description:
Problem: We lack a robust way to compare current p95/p99 latency behavior against a stable, explainable baseline across the three-dimensional slice of route/model/region. Existing dashboards show raw quantiles but do not provide anchored baselines, directional deltas, or a structured way to surface likely root causes that map to deployment changes, kernel improvements, or traffic-shape shifts.

Goal: Build a baseline anchoring pipeline and a "root cause lattice" UI that correlates deviations in p95/p99 with candidate causes (model variant, kernel selection, batch size changes, region capacity events, input token distribution shifts). Deliverables include telemetry enrichment, an aggregation/anchoring service, regression detection rules, and a pair of dashboards (operational and forensic) per route/model/region.

Success metrics: alert precision >60% for true regressions (triaged by oncall), reduction in mean time to detect root cause by 30%, and coverage for >=80% of high-volume routes within first rollout phase.
acceptance_criteria: Anchoring pipeline computes a rolling baseline (7d median + IQR) for p50/p95/p99 per route+model+region at 1m granularity
Delta panels show percent and absolute change vs baseline with sparklines and significance flag (z-score > 2)
Root Cause Lattice UI surfaces top 5 correlated signals (model change, kernel change, batch-size, KV-cache hit-rate, tokens/sec shift) with explanatory text
Regression detector emits events to alerting pipeline and creates a triage issue when sustained for 15m
Dashboards include a time-travel selector to view baseline windows and compare historical anchors
Data retention for quantile rollups is at least 90d for forensic queries
Unit and integration tests for the anchoring logic with synthetic traffic show <5% false positives on known stable traces
tasks: Define anchoring algorithm and parameters (window, statistic, smoothing) — owner: Diego
Add telemetry tags to request spans: model_variant, kernel_profile, batch_hint, region, route — owner: Sienna
Implement quantile-rollup job with baseline snapshots stored in timeseries store — owner: Backend Team
Create regression detector that computes z-score against baseline and pushes events to alerts bus — owner: Reliability
Design Root Cause Lattice UI mockups and acceptance flows — owner: Design (hand-off link in comment)
Build operational dashboard (summary) and forensic dashboard (drilldown) — owner: Observability
Run gated rollout on 10 high-volume routes for 2 weeks and collect precision/recall metrics — owner: Oncall
Document runbook and create automatic triage playbook for common root cause patterns — owner: SRE
telemetry_schema: Quantile rollups are emitted at 1m; fields: timestamp, route, model, model_variant, region, backend_zone, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, tokens_per_sec, kv_cache_hit_rate, batch_size_hint, request_count. Anchoring job computes baseline_median_ms and baseline_iqr_ms; detector computes z_score_p95 and sustained_duration_minutes.
rollout_plan: Phase 1: telemetry tagging and batch of baseline jobs against historical 90d data (staging) — 2 weeks. Phase 2: deploy detector in read-only mode (alerts suppressed) for 1 week and evaluate noise. Phase 3: enable alerts for a canary cohort of 10 routes for 2 weeks. Phase 4: full rollout with playbook and pager escalation. Each phase gated by quantitative acceptance checks listed in AC.
